name: Tree
description:
The navigation tree (a sidebar's records grouped by owner). Groups collapse; leaf rows
are fa-item rows, two lines with a description, with an optional status dot on the icon. Keyboard: ↑ ↓ move,
→ opens or enters a group, ← closes or returns to the parent, Home / End, Enter selects
(toggles a group), and typing jumps to the next matching name. One row is tabbable (roving
tabindex). Rows are virtualised, so thousands of rows cost only the rows on screen.
signature: ({ nodes, selectedId, onSelect, renderLink, rowWrapper, renderContent, expanded: expandedProp, defaultExpanded, onExpandedChange, query, emptyText, className, "aria-label": label, }: TreeProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Initially expanded nodes when expansion is uncontrolled.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: The line shown when nothing matches. Default: No match for “query”.

props.name: nodes
props.description: Graph or tree nodes with stable identifiers and relationships.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called with the full list of open group ids whenever a group opens or closes (click, Enter, Space or the arrow keys); groups do not toggle while searching. Pair with `expanded` to control it.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the endpoint (leaf) the person activates by click, Enter or Space; not for groups, which toggle, or disabled rows. A linked row also navigates. Pair with `selectedId` to show the selection.

props.name: query
props.description:
Filter text from the search field above the tree. Matching branches open and the
match is highlighted.

props.name: renderContent
props.type: ((node: TreeNode, content: TreeRowContent) => ReactNode | null) | undefined
props.description:
Draw a row's content (after the chevron) yourself, e.g. an entity identity's row tier,
so a tree row is the same object as the entity's table cell and header. The row keeps
its own states (fa-item: hover, focus, selected) and height. Return null for the
default icon, label and description.

props.name: renderLink
props.type: ((node: TreeNode, props: TreeRowRenderProps) => ReactElement | null) | undefined

props.name: rowWrapper
props.description:
Wrap each row element, e.g. in ActionContextMenu so right-click, long-press, Shift+F10
and the Menu key open the row's actions (R11.6). Must render the row it is given.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: Stable identifier of the selected item.
